notes: Customer-facing catalogue of staircase PLANS the customer can pick when requesting a quote.
This is a separate seed from the renovation gallery (categories) manifest ·
renovations = finishes / styles / feature choices · plans = geometry / layout / design.
To add a plan: drop image into public/staircase-renovations/plans/<slug>.png,
then add an object below with slug + label + optional description + src.
Empty array is honest: `Choose a plan` renders an empty state until Philip seeds real plans.
